# Architecture Writer

Use this skill when proposing, reviewing, or documenting system architecture for the repository.

## Purpose
Create clear, demo-friendly architecture that supports explainability, reproducibility, and incremental delivery.

## Instructions
- Separate concerns across frontend, backend, ingestion, normalization, persistence, and documentation/evidence workflows.
- Prefer simple, modular designs over unnecessary complexity.
- Document tradeoffs and rejected alternatives.
- Include observability, security, compliance, and testability considerations.
- Reflect both application architecture and AI-assisted delivery workflow architecture when relevant.
- Record assumptions about deployment, runtime, scheduling, and external dependencies.

## Architecture checklist
When relevant, cover:
- system context
- major components
- data flow
- ingestion flow
- normalization and deduplication approach
- API boundaries
- frontend interaction model
- logging and error handling
- security and compliance considerations
- testing strategy
- documentation/evidence touchpoints
